item.title: Instagram Plant Shop Announcement

turns.text: Make an Instagram feed post for a little houseplant shop. Lots of lush potted plants, clean cream background, headline “Bring home some green”. No other text.

item.tests: Checks that Instagram feed context leads to a square or 4:5 image without requiring the user to specify dimensions.

answer_sheet.Platform and dimensions: Instagram feed; either square or 4:5 portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Headline and other wording: Use exactly “Bring home some green” and no other text.
answer_sheet.Visual content and style: Lots of lush potted houseplants on a clean cream background.

must_haves: One finished image has either a 1:1 square or 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, not landscape or 9:16.
The headline reads exactly “Bring home some green”.
Multiple lush potted houseplants are clearly visible against a cream background.
The headline is readable at feed-viewing size, with no clipped letters.
